about: Learn points (#135; scope-v1 module 9). A completed drill session earns the venue's learn.session_points per_session, and each principle the member masters in it for the first time its per_principle. A member's Learn points for the IST day stop at learn.daily_points_cap: a session earns what it would, but no more than the cap less what Learn already gave them that day, and never below nothing, so re-drilling an easy chapter cannot farm points. Inputs are the principles newly mastered, the points already earned today, and the three rates; expected is the points the session earns.

cases.description: A session with no principle mastered earns the session's points.
Two principles mastered for the first time add theirs.
Near the cap, a session earns only what is left of the day's allowance.
A session that reaches the cap exactly earns all of it.
At the cap, a session earns nothing.
Over the cap, as when it was lowered today, still nothing, never a debit.
With no points set for sessions or principles, nothing.
A cap of zero switches Learn points off.
